format: html

## Purpose

Validate the six downstream-only exclusions and exact model universe.

## Inputs

Maximum-duration resident AUC effects, climate context, taxonomy, and full sampling covariance.

## Decisions and exclusions

Exactly the six configured taxa are removed here and nowhere upstream.

## Before/after counts and validation checks

```{r}
scope <- targets::tar_read(downstream_scope_526)
settings <- targets::tar_read(canonical_downstream_settings)
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  effects = scope$effects, species = scope$species, experiments = scope$experiments
))
knitr::kable(data.frame(excluded_downstream_only = settings$exclusions))
knitr::kable(scope$V_validation)
```

## Problems flagged

Any count, identity, covariance, ordering, or required-consistency mismatch stops this branch.

## Canonical outputs

`downstream_auc_data`, `downstream_V_auc`, and `downstream_scope_526`.

## PASS/FAIL

The target stops unless the scope is exactly 1,604 effects, 526 species, and 42 experiments.
